summary.text: Steven Long is a Republican state representative from South Carolina House District 37 who has served since November 2016 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a real estate broker and serves on the House Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: Steven Long graduated from Boiling Springs High School, earned an associate degree from Spartanburg Community College in 2014 and a bachelor's degree from the University of South Carolina Upstate in 2015.
His career experience includes working as a real estate broker.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he also has prior experience in insurance and in industrial and hazardous-material environmental services, and that he lives in Inman with his wife and three children.
Long assumed office on November 14, 2016, and was assigned to the Ways and Means Committee for 2025-2026.
In the survey he said he is also vice-chair of an Economic Development ad hoc committee and serves on a regulations committee.
He listed tax relief, road improvements, government efficiency and responsible budgeting, and state action against illegal immigration among his priorities.
The Republican primary for the 2026 election was canceled.
